failure_modes: Selecting C003 (native_rms_ratio 0.5) or C005/C006 (time_ramp_power 1.0/2.0) would increase injection RMS and displace surrounding coordinates without any validated affinity benefit, since the audit metrics are geometric teacher-proximity diagnostics, not the score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian.

Adopting the time-conditioned regional-attention recipe on the basis of sign-changing landmark contrasts would over-fit weakly identified observed-node fits (relative node RMSE up to 0.78, strong sign conflicts present) and could be misread as a trajectory velocity force.

Treating last-record survival credit or compressed-choice excess fixed RMS as final affinity benefit would be a survivor-biased inference, because 349 nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and no decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied.
result.rationale: D1.2: The registered time-conditioned alternative (temporal_teacher/temporal_region) changes regional attention at observed score nodes using the same static teachers; it does not move teacher coordinates and is not a velocity force. Analyst's temporal evidence (continuous:0-5) shows sign-changing landmark contrasts with 4-10 sign changes, 1-9 strong sign conflicts and relative node RMSE 0.29-0.78, so a time-conditioned rule is only weakly identified at these nodes and a stationary coordinate target is not clearly dominated. D3.2: The offered schedule choices are dose-only (native_rms_ratio C001-C003) or ramp-only (time_ramp_power C004-C006). Delivery diagnostics show mean delivered/calibration ~0.33 with zero cap-active, zero backtrack and zero post-window injection across all 8 batches, i.e. the fixed schedule already delivers uniformly over the full learned support [0.0,0.5] with no saturation; there is no coverage deficit to justify reallocating dose, and target motion must not be conflated with control strength. D4.1: The incumbent (native_rms_ratio 0.33, time_ramp_power 0.0) is exactly the offered C002/C004 values, so no offered edit differs from the incumbent in a way supported by evidence; the information audit states the geometric teacher-proximity metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and are not a validated affinity predictor, so no defensible expected affinity advantage exists. D4.2: Opposing evidence predicts that raising dose (C003) or adding a late ramp (C005/C006) would displace surrounding coordinates without an affinity-validated benefit, since the excess-distance contrast is geometric and the objective is affinity-primary; this predicted unnecessary displacement keeps the design at the incumbent. Retaining the incumbent is therefore the evidence-supported choice; no temperature edit is proposed.
